events.title: Demo Update #10: Bat Wall Mount & Shop Expansion License
events.summary: Hello, bookies! ⚾ A smaller update this time, starting with something for the shop's walls. A place for your batYour baseball bat usually ends up lying on the floor or leaning against the counter. Now it can go on the wall. The Bat Wall Mount is in the tablet shop under Furniture, next to the stands. Put it on any wall, look at it with the bat in your hand and hang the bat. events.title: Demo Update #9: IRON CAGE Fight Night & Night Edition
events.summary: Hello, bookies! 🥊 This one starts with something new on the TVs. IRON CAGE is hereEvery evening at 18:00 the BS CAGE channel goes live. Eight fighters walk into the cage at the same time. There are no rounds and no rules, and the last one standing takes the belt. Expect chairs, someone climbing a ladder to jump on a pile of fighters, and a lot of people lying on the floor by the end of the night.
